metadata.purpose: Canonical locale -> season -> local produce/source lookup for the 'Local flavor' island. Month-aware: each market lists produce entries with an inclusive month window (1-12). local_flavor_for(market_code, month) returns the in-season entries for that month plus the sourcing string. Seeded from the frontend flavorMap so the DATA layer is authoritative and the UI can fetch this file instead of hardcoding JS.
metadata.month_convention: months are integers 1-12 (January=1). Windows are inclusive and may wrap the year end (e.g. start 11, end 2 spans Nov-Feb). year_round entries use months 1-12.
metadata.consumed_by: src/creative_automation/local_flavor.py :: local_flavor_for(market_code, month) -> {produce, source, months, in_season}

US-CA-PESCADERO.source: Pescadero farm stands + Half Moon Bay / Santa Cruz stands

US-WA-NEAHBAY.source: Neah Bay harbor, Washburn's General Store & Makah Days

US-SW-LASCRUCES.source: roasted by the bushel, Organ Mountains bench, Albertsons Las Cruces

US-UT-KAMASVALLEY.place: Kamas Valley — Peoa / Oakley, UT 84036 (Wasatch Back rural)

_default.source: local harvest — source determined by locale to drive engagement & conversion
